title: 2026’s Best Anime Has a Twist That Makes One Character Feel Like the Gojo Replacement Fans Needed
content: Satoru Gojo from Jujutsu Kaisen has become an icon in the anime industry, emerging as one of its biggest faces in recent years, and it would not be an overstatement to say that he helped push anime further into the mainstream. He reached that level thanks to the many incredible traits his character possesses.
